records.title: What Governs Decode Throughput in Absolute-Offset GPU LZ77? A Work-Granularity Mechanism and an Encode-Time Min-Match-Length Lever
records.reason: This paper analyzes GPU LZ77 lossless decompression. It attributes throughput to average match length and adjusts the encoder minimum-match-length to improve compression ratio and the decode kernel; measurements are H100/device-resident generic data. It explicitly excludes entropy/host transfer timing and is not LLM weights, activations, KV cache, or serving compression. The corrupted lineage text does not establish a technical bridge.

records.title: The Balkanization of Execution-Security Research for AI Coding Agents: Isolation, Access Control, and Time-of-Check-to-Time-of-Use Vulnerabilities
records.reason: The SoK closely overlaps the linked agent execution-security lineage, but its subject is isolation/access-control/TOCTOU taxonomy and defenses rather than LLM inference, serving, or inference-time efficiency. Whether the repository accepts this adjacent security literature is a scope question; no performance or serving contribution is claimed.

records.title: HGenPush: A Heterogeneous Generative Recommendation Architecture for Industrial Push Notification Systems
records.reason: The abstract describes an industrial generative recommendation architecture; it does not identify LLM inference/serving efficiency as its contribution.

records.title: Medical question answering: A comprehensive multimodal and LLM-driven survey
records.reason: The paper is a medical QA survey of multimodal/LLM applications, not a concrete inference or serving optimization.

records.title: MLO TTLM Optimization for IEEE 802.11bn IoT Networks Through Federated Learning Supported Transformer-Based Correlation Estimation
records.reason: The primary abstract is a federated-learning transformer for Wi-Fi 8 link mapping/IoT network performance, not LLM inference.
